properties.description:
The guard for the class this codebase has fixed four times: BL-46, BL-166, BL-183, and set_verification_status erasing last_run_at. Each case sets a property off its default, re-calls the write the way a reviser would, and asserts the design still knows what it knew. Every case failed before its fix.

It also carries the two controls that keep the fix honest in the other direction: a property the caller DOES name is still overwritten, and an explicitly-passed optional still wins. Without those, "preserve on omission" could quietly become "you may never change this back", which would be the same bug pointing the other way.

REGISTERED ON 2026-09-07, WHICH IS LATE AND IS PART OF THE STORY. The file that guards the class was itself outside the design record, so nothing connected it to the four defects it exists to catch, and its scope error was invisible to every report. Its membership was drawn on `add_*` call names rather than on the behaviour, which is why link_artifact stayed half-fixed for three weeks while this file's own header vouched for it.
properties.name: constructors_preserve.rs — the class guard: a write path that builds a node from a partial property set must not erase what the design already knew
